title: Living and Non-Living Things
parentNote: This unit covers the basic differences between living and non-living things. Help your child spot examples around the house!
learnBullets: Know what **living things** are and their characteristics
Understand that living things **need food, water, and air**
Learn that living things **grow, move, and reproduce**
Identify examples of **living and non-living things** around us
learnItFirst:
**1. What are Living Things?**

Living things are things that are **alive**. They can:
- **Breathe** (need air)
- **Eat** (need food)
- **Drink** (need water)
- **Grow** (become bigger)
- **Move** (on their own)
- **Reproduce** (have babies)
- **Feel** (respond to things around them)

**Examples:** Humans, animals, birds, insects, fish, plants, trees

---

**2. What are Non-Living Things?**

Non-living things are things that are **not alive**. They:
- Do NOT breathe
- Do NOT eat or drink
- Do NOT grow on their own
- Do NOT have babies
- Cannot move on their own

**Examples:** Chair, table, stone, water, toys, books, car, bicycle

---

**3. Special Cases**

- **Plants** are living things even though they don't walk around!
- **Dead things** (like dry leaves, wooden furniture) were once living but are not alive now
- **Water, air** are non-living but living things need them to survive

---

**4. Easy Way to Remember**

Ask: "Can it breathe? Can it grow on its own? Can it have babies?"
- If YES to all → **Living**
- If NO to all → **Non-Living**

---

questions.content: Which of these is a living thing?
questions.why: A dog is alive — it breathes, eats, grows, and moves

questions.content: Which of these is a non-living thing?
questions.why: A book is not alive — it cannot breathe, eat, or grow

questions.content: Living things need ___ to breathe.
questions.why: All living things need air to breathe and stay alive

questions.content: Which of these can grow?
questions.why: A plant is a living thing and can grow bigger

questions.content: A bird is a ___.
questions.why: A bird is alive — it breathes, eats, grows, flies, and lays eggs

questions.content: Which of these can move on its own?
questions.why: A butterfly can fly and move on its own because it is a living thing

questions.content: Living things need ___ to drink.
questions.why: All living things need water to survive

questions.content: Which of these is NOT a living thing?
questions.why: A rock is not alive — it cannot breathe, eat, or grow

questions.content: A fish is a living thing because it can ___.
questions.why: Fish breathe (through gills), swim, eat, and grow — all signs of life

questions.content: Which of these needs food to live?
questions.why: A rabbit is a living thing and needs food to stay alive

questions.content: Which of the following is TRUE about living things?
questions.why: Living things grow bigger and can have babies (reproduce)

questions.content: A wooden table is a non-living thing. The wood came from a ___.
questions.why: Wood comes from trees. Trees are living, but when cut and made into furniture, it becomes non-living

questions.content: Riya saw a thing that breathes, eats, and grows. It is most likely a ___.
questions.why: Breathing, eating, and growing are characteristics of living things

questions.content: Which of these groups has ONLY living things?
questions.why: Tree, flower, and grass are all plants — all are living things

questions.content: Plants are living things. How do they get their food?

options.A: They make their own food using sunlight

questions.why: Plants make their own food using sunlight, water, and air

questions.content: Which of these can have babies?
questions.why: A hen is a living thing and can lay eggs (have babies)

questions.content: Amit's toy car can move when he pushes it. Is the toy car living?

options.B: No, it cannot move on its own

questions.why: The toy car needs someone to push it — it cannot move on its own, so it's non-living

questions.content: Which of these groups has ONLY non-living things?
questions.why: Chair, table, and cup are all non-living things

questions.content: A dead leaf on the ground is ___.
questions.why: A dead leaf was once part of a living tree, but now it is not alive anymore

questions.content: Water is a non-living thing, but living things need it to ___.
questions.why: All living things need water to survive and stay healthy

questions.content: Which living thing does NOT have legs but can still move?
questions.why: A snake has no legs but can crawl and move on its own

questions.content: A robot can walk and talk. Is it a living thing?
questions.why: A robot is a machine — it cannot breathe, eat, grow, or have babies on its own

questions.content: Which of these can feel hot and cold?
questions.why: Humans can feel hot and cold — living things can respond to their surroundings

questions.content: Meena planted a seed. After some days, a small plant came out. This shows that ___.
questions.why: Seeds are living and can grow into new plants when given water, soil, and sunlight

questions.content: Which of these statements is CORRECT?

options.B: Living things need food, water, and air

questions.why: All living things — animals and plants — need food, water, and air to survive

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: These questions are a bit tricky. Think carefully!

questions.content: Rahul says, "My bicycle can move, so it is a living thing." Is Rahul correct?

options.B: No, the bicycle cannot move on its own without someone riding it
options.C: Yes, because the bicycle has wheels
options.D: Yes, because it is made of metal

questions.why: A bicycle needs someone to ride it — it cannot move, breathe, eat, or grow on its own

questions.content: Which of these was ONCE a living thing but is now non-living?
questions.why: Leather comes from animal skin — the animal was once living, but leather is now non-living

questions.content: Priya's plant does not walk or run, but it is still a living thing. Why?

options.A: Because it grows, needs water, and makes seeds
options.C: Because it is in a pot

questions.why: Plants grow, need water and sunlight, and make seeds (reproduce) — all signs of life

questions.content: A car needs petrol to run. A human needs food to live. Which statement is TRUE?

options.A: Human is living; car is a machine
options.C: Both car and human are living things
options.D: Car is living because it needs petrol

questions.why: A human is a living thing (breathes, eats, grows). A car is a machine — it cannot grow or have babies

questions.content: Rohan found something in the garden. It does not breathe. It does not eat. It does not grow. But it was once part of a living thing. What could it be?
questions.why: A dry twig came from a tree (living thing) but is now dead and non-living
